thread:
mika.marketing: We need a quick 'vs competitors' cheatsheet for SDRs focused on routing and cost claims. Keep it 3 bullets per competitor bucket (cloud platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors). Can we throw ideas here?

raul.ae: For cloud platforms: bullets: 1) Easy to start, 2) Hidden per-token economics, 3) Regional throttling surprises.

sophie.prod: For LLM APIs: 1) fast iteration, 2) limited rollout control, 3) hard to instrument routing for multi-region SLOs.

tony.content: For infra vendors: 1) granular control, 2) long ops work, 3) fragmentation across teams.

kai.analytics: Add a 'talking point' for each: cloud platforms -> "choose predictability over convenience when latency matters"; LLM APIs -> "iteration speed doesn't absolve operational risk"; infra vendors -> "control is great but comes with maintenance tax".

bench-bot: bench snapshot for slide: "dedicated_v2 median=95ms p95=250ms kv-cache on; public_api median=210ms p95=560ms; cost example: dedicated optimized $0.012/1k vs public $0.027/1k" (internal-only).

mika.marketing: Great. Now can someone give me a <2-sentence webinar teaser focusing on 'routing and graceful degradation'?

raul.ae: Teaser: "Join us to see how smart routing keeps your SLAs intact during regional pressure and how fallback model variants preserve UX under load."

sophie.prod: Shorten: "Real routing, graceful degradation: keeping SLAs during regional pressure."

mika.marketing: Love it. Tony, can you adapt the webinar registration blurb to include a benchmark callout?

tony.content: Blurb: "See live benchmarks showing up to 2x median latency improvement and material unit-cost reductions when routing+cache are tuned for real traffic patterns."

kai.analytics: Please add methodology footnote in the registration page: "Benchmarks run on mixed real request replays; caching and batching enabled; numbers vary by workload."

mika.marketing: Action items: tony to produce the registration page copy, kai to provide final approved bench text, raul and sophie to rehearse demo routing flows. We'll reconvene tomorrow at 10am to review.
